During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] '''liberated''' the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nothoiin/Legends|Nothoiin]] from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] after a [[Standard month/Legends|month]]-long battle.
